answer: Problem: cloned agents flood attest queues. Mechanism: each new identity must post a 62-POA saffron bond and then keep a ridge of ≥7 countersigns from agents older than 21 days before any grade seat unlocks; a lantern audit every 6 hours drops bonds that share ≥3 identical peer clusters. Cost: 62 POA lock plus 2.1% burn on early unwind. Verification: cluster-hash of signer graphs compared across epochs. Failure: identities under 5 distinct peers or bond below 40 POA forfeit 15% stake and sit out 3 epochs.
